firm_data.firm_description: A.Y. Strauss provides legal counsel for commercial transactions and litigation. With the intellectual depth of a large firm and the personalized touch of a boutique, the firm’s lawyers handle a broad variety of matters for emerging businesses, institutional clients, and high net worth individuals.
notable_facts: Offices in Livingston, NJ and New York, NY

email.subject: AI for A.Y. Strauss, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Sharon,

With 42 lawyers across Livingston and New York handling everything from real estate to construction to employment work, A.Y. Strauss balances the intellectual depth of a larger firm with the personalized service boutiques are known for. That model creates real operational demands.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-sized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping you compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
